ai.headline: Dropbox expands its terms to cover AI-related features, e-signatures, and faxing
ai.summary: Dropbox's updated terms add new rules: Dropbox can access, store, and scan your files to provide features like OCR and previews, and this permission now extends to affiliates and trusted third parties. The terms also add e-signature and fax service rules, a clearer statement that third-party integrations are not Dropbox's responsibility, and broader grounds for suspending accounts without notice, including when Dropbox "reasonably believes" a violation occurred. Users cannot export their files after suspension or termination, and U.S. users' arbitration clause now covers claims "arising out of" the terms.
ai.what_you_can_do: Non-U.S. and U.S. users can opt out of mandatory arbitration by submitting the opt-out form within 30 days of first registering or agreeing to these Terms (the text links to the form).
